findings.actualPrimary: LehrplanPLUS B12-EA.2.4, whole current original official EA HTML genetics section; antecedent die is Proteinvielfalt
findings.literalProblem: DE makes the object of als Voraussetzung unclear; EN it explicitly refers back to alternative splicing. Splicing itself is not a necessary prerequisite of evolutionary selection. The source refers to protein diversity.
findings.independentMechanism: Heritable phenotypic variation and differential reproductive success allow selection. Alternative splicing is one possible contributor, and temporary somatic splice changes alone do not establish inheritance or selection. Both full cases correctly retain these distinctions.
findings.neededBoundedRemedy: Make the actual DE/EN goal state the contribution of splicing to protein diversity and the conditional relevance of heritable variation to selection, without making splicing universally necessary. Preserve original source text/operator and exact case history. Rebind affected goal-dependent evidence only after a genuine targeted review.

findings.literalProblem: Beide Gameten einer dihybriden Person haben AB/Ab/aB/ab mit je 1/4 Wahrscheinlichkeit.
findings.correctCurrentEnglish: each dihybrid parent makes AB/Ab/aB/ab with probability1/4
findings.independentMechanism: A gamete has one allele per locus. Each parent produces four possible gamete types in this independent-locus model; two gametes are not the four types. The9 genotype classes and worked cross probabilities are otherwise correct.
findings.neededBoundedRemedy: Correct the DE supplied sentence to both parents each producing the four gamete types, and the duplicate actual profile taskDemandDe. Preserve original material history, whole goal, EN and numerical calculations.

EA alternativesplicing/antisense/HIV/antibiotic/repair/knockout/epigenetics and GA active protein-chain/PCR/karyotype cases are explicitly distinguished. Broad regulation clauses retain separate DNA methylation/TF and all other partner/content duties. No full jurisdiction/course view is approved.
